name: Glute Bridge

instructions.description: Lie on the back with knees bent and feet flat.
Gently brace the abdomen and press through the feet.
Lift the hips until the trunk and thighs form a comfortable line.
Lower the hips slowly while breathing normally.

variations.variationDescription: Single-Leg Glute Bridge meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Glute Bridge.
Glute Bridge — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Glute Bridge — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use a comfortable hip range without forcing the lower back.
